text: Program Description Labor Health and Environmental Sanitationis an important branch of public Health and preventive medicine. It studies the relationship between working conditions, natural environment and living environment and people's health, and reveals the occurrence and development of environmental factors and occupational harmful factors on people's health. It also studies the countermeasures to control adverse environmental factors and occupational hazards by utilizing favorable environmental factors, and to prevent occupational diseases and environment-related diseases, so as to ensure the health of the population. Occupational and environmental health is an applied is stronger, the multidisciplinary cross comprehensive discipline, in addition to analytical chemistry, molecular biology, physiology, biochemistry, immunology and other medical disciplines, toxicology and health statistics, epidemiology and preventive medicine, and most closely related to clinical medical disciplines, also involves ecology, meteorology, psychology and human ergonomics, etc. Duration 3 years
